chunks.heading: Project - Man Eater
chunks.notes: The single chunk covers the whole story -- Fisk mentally catalogues a stack of escalating wrongnesses (inward-facing armor, sick/anorexic crew, claw marks, unnatural cold, arbitrary rules) before the Windigo reveal, then is himself starved-then-fed into transformation by the complicit Sam, ending on the flat gut-punch line "He was like an animal in a zoo... The end."
